supplemental_code_rescoring.policy: Accept permitted safe standard-library solutions; enforce executable edge cases, immutability and counted binary-search accesses. Raw benchmark.jsonl remains unchanged.

supplemental_scalar_rescoring: If quality_diagnostics.json exists, apply scoring_v2.py. It avoids interpreting 'our answer is correct' as a final-answer anchor. Preserve raw_primary_correct alongside rescored values.
interpretation: Task-paired descriptive intervals. Original set was reused during selection. Small heldout/coding sets do not establish noninferiority; code tests cannot prove general completeness.

original_path_reproduction.timing_scope: Legacy total_seconds is generation plus donor forward for the patch, excluding tokenization and decoding. Use matching model_seconds_including_donor from the cached matrix for before/after speed ratios; main-matrix total_seconds is full request time.
